style: cinematic 3D animation, Pixar-quality chitin shading, matte surfaces, deadpan slapstick
shot: vertical, low angle from the nest entrance, orbital drift all film; camera pushes in on the padlock and scanner pad from 2.5s, no cuts
character: WASP: burst-start zero to full speed; two-phase stop, wings jerk once more; double head-jerk overshoot; wings clap out of sync; sharp head-snap turns; same design throughout
cast: BEE CASHIER: heavy monolithic clerk, decides from the torso, lands full-weight, one full-amplitude swing; same design throughout
props: hive-computer: branch wax comb as one flat screen, one support only; grid of colored hexagon icons, one plain glyph each, no letters, no logos; metal padlock on a hinge; flat scanner pad in the bee's thorax; one nectar drop nearby
setting: sunlit meadow at high noon, the branch is the only support in frame
lighting: hard overhead midday sun, crisp highlights, strong contrast, sharp shadows, no haze

audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry deadpan, steady, unrushed, native Russian, no accent, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: even rate, ~4-4.5 syll/sec, beats adjoin with no gap, finishes with room to spare
audio.lip_sync: mouthparts open and close each syllable, voice comes from the wasp, never a voiceover
audio.pronunciation: «плачу»: stress on second syllable, pla-CHOO not PLA-cha; even pace, no pause before it

timeline.a: Burst-start, chest slams the screen at full speed, rebounds a body-length, two-phase stop: body locks, wings jerk once more
Double head-jerk overshoot at the padlock; a leg reaches the hinge, recoils on touch, body rocks
Bee drops onto the branch, full weight, branch sways; one torso-turn spins the screen to the lens, icon grid flares on
Wasp hits the grid in a hit-bounce-hit series; each icon blinks out, jerks sideways; after the third hit she grimaces
Jabs the center icon, padlock snaps shut over the grid with a clang, knocks her back half a body-length
Bee turns her torso to the lens, padlock and thorax scanner pad fill the frame
timeline.camera: push-in begins, holds to the end

timeline.a: Stinger presses flat against the pad; a spark, two-tone signal, stinger yanks back sharply, body sways
Padlock hangs shut, antennae flick once, wasp's weight already shifting back for the lunge
Whole body snaps sideways across the frame, wings blur, chest and forelegs slam onto the nectar drop with a splash, droplets scattering, rocks back upright; mouthparts free, open on each syllable
Bee throws her weight onto the shackle, wrenches it half a turn; wasp's mouth moves for the line
Shackle springs open with a click; wasp's mouth continues the line
Wasp's wings clap shut in one sharp sweep, resolving the earlier out-of-sync flapping; mouth finishes the line
Bee hooks the open padlock on her abdomen as a trophy, jingle; wasp lunges into the screen's gap, wings beat out of sync to tear free
Sharp push, she's inside, screen slams shut with a thud, dust puff; head snaps to lens, abdomen trembles in tight pulses

negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, low key; slow speech; extra insects, human hands; real brand logos, readable text, subtitles, watermark; English speech, foreign accent; cuts, jump cuts, static camera; floating objects, duplicate props; extra limbs, character changes mid-shot
motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses, slams, or fills frame — never only a small limb moving alone
